# 查询视频生成任务(官方格式

## OpenAPI Specification

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /qwen/api/v1/tasks/{task_id}:
    get:
      summary: 查询视频生成任务(官方格式
      deprecated: false
      description: >-
        官方文档链接：

        https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/wan3-video-generation-api-reference
      operationId: getVideoGenerationTask
      tags:
        - 视频模型/qwen_wan3
        - VideoGeneration
      parameters:
        - name: task_id
          in: path
          description: 创建任务接口返回的任务 ID，有效期为 24 小时。
          required: true
          example: ''
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: Authorization
          in: header
          description: ''
          required: false
          example: Bearer {{YOUR_API_KEY}}
          schema:
            type: string
            default: Bearer {{YOUR_API_KEY}}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 查询成功。具体字段随任务状态变化。
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required:
                  - request_id
                  - output
                properties:
                  request_id:
                    type: string
                    description: 请求唯一标识。
                  output:
                    type: object
                    required:
                      - task_id
                      - task_status
                    properties:
                      task_id:
                        type: string
                        description: 任务 ID。
                      task_status:
                        type: string
                        enum:
                          - PENDING
                          - RUNNING
                          - SUCCEEDED
                          - FAILED
                          - CANCELED
                          - UNKNOWN
                      submit_time:
                        type: string
                        description: 任务提交时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS。
                        examples:
                          - '2026-08-06 10:01:35.452'
                      scheduled_time:
                        type: string
                        description: 任务开始执行时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS。
                        examples:
                          - '2026-08-06 10:01:35.507'
                      end_time:
                        type: string
                        description: 任务完成时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS。
                        examples:
                          - '2026-08-06 10:13:33.838'
                      orig_prompt:
                        type: string
                        description: 原始提示词。
                      video_url:
                        type: string
                        format: uri
                        description: 成功生成的视频 URL，有效期为 24 小时。
                      code:
                        type: string
                        description: 任务失败时返回的错误码。
                      message:
                        type: string
                        description: 任务失败时返回的错误详情。
                    x-apifox-orders:
                      - task_id
                      - task_status
                      - submit_time
                      - scheduled_time
                      - end_time
                      - orig_prompt
                      - video_url
                      - code
                      - message
                  usage:
                    type: object
                    description: 仅在任务成功时返回的输出统计。
                    properties:
                      video_count:
                        type: integer
                        enum:
                          - 1
                        description: 生成视频数量，固定为 1。
                      duration:
                        type: number
                        format: float
                        description: 生成视频时长，单位为秒。
                      input_video_duration:
                        type: number
                        format: float
                        description: 输入视频总时长，单位为秒；无视频输入时为 0。
                      output_video_duration:
                        type: number
                        format: float
                        description: 输出视频时长，单位为秒。
                      fps:
                        type: integer
                        default: 30
                        description: 输出视频帧率。
                      SR:
                        type: integer
                        description: 输出视频分辨率数值，例如 720。
                      ratio:
                        type: string
                        description: 输出视频宽高比。
                    x-apifox-orders:
                      - video_count
                      - duration
                      - input_video_duration
                      - output_video_duration
                      - fps
                      - SR
                      - ratio
                x-apifox-orders:
                  - request_id
                  - output
                  - usage
              examples:
                succeeded:
                  summary: 任务成功
                  value:
                    request_id: 78c9b768-0285-996c-b682-xxxxxx
                    output:
                      task_id: 17ed7e50-00cf-4509-aea1-xxxxxx
                      task_status: SUCCEEDED
                      submit_time: '2026-08-06 10:01:35.452'
                      scheduled_time: '2026-08-06 10:01:35.507'
                      end_time: '2026-08-06 10:13:33.838'
                      orig_prompt: A golden retriever running on a sunny beach.
                      video_url: https://example.com/video.mp4
                    usage:
                      video_count: 1
                      duration: 5
                      input_video_duration: 0
                      output_video_duration: 5
                      fps: 30
                      SR: 720
                      ratio: '16:9'
                failed:
                  summary: 任务失败
                  value:
                    request_id: e5e57877-c0fc-47ed-8fad-xxxxxx
                    output:
                      task_id: eff1443c-ccab-4676-aad3-xxxxxx
                      task_status: FAILED
                      code: InvalidParameter
                      message: The two modes are mutually exclusive.
                unknown:
                  summary: 任务已过期或不存在
                  value:
                    request_id: a4de7c32-7057-9f82-8581-xxxxxx
                    output:
                      task_id: 502a00b1-19d9-4839-a82f-xxxxxx
                      task_status: UNKNOWN
          headers: {}
          x-apifox-name: ''
        '401':
          description: API Key 缺失或无效。
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required:
                  - code
                  - message
                  - request_id
                properties:
                  code:
                    type: string
                  message:
                    type: string
                  request_id:
                    type: string
                x-apifox-orders:

                  - request_id
              example:
                code: InvalidApiKey

                request_id: 7438d53d-6eb8-4596-8835-xxxxxx
          headers: {}
          x-apifox-name: ''
        default:
          description: 其他错误。
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  code:
                    type: string
                  message:
                    type: string
                  request_id:
                    type: string
                x-apifox-orders:
                  - code
                  - message
                  - request_id
          headers: {}
          x-apifox-name: ''
      security: []
      x-apifox-folder: 视频模型/qwen_wan3
      x-apifox-status: released
      x-run-in-apifox: https://app.apifox.com/web/project/3868318/apis/api-505913153-run

  schemas: {}
```
